pageCache.pageTitle: Private Pre-Prep & Nursery in Surrey - Glenesk School
pageCache.text:
Welcome to Glenesk School
At Glenesk Pre-Prep and Nursery School, we specialise in providing an exceptional educational foundation for children between the age of 2 and 7 years old. We believe that childhood should be a time of wonder, exploration, and joy. That’s why we make it our mission to ensure that your child’s day is filled with special moments of Glenesk magic, every day.
Excellent Early Years provision
Our inspirational and passionate Early Years specialist teachers offer your child an outstanding start to their educational journey. They are committed to providing a stimulating, secure and inspiring environment, helping your child reach their full potential.
Prepared for the future
At Glenesk, every child receives the individual attention and support they need to thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. Our children are uniquely prepared for entry at Year 3 to the best selective schools, with many achieving academic or sporting scholarships.
A nurturing and caring environment
Glenesk is not just a school; it’s a home away from home, where your child will feel valued, and excited to learn. Our small class sizes help to ensure that every child’s individuality in all areas is recognised, nurtured and celebrated.
Welcome to Glenesk School
At Glenesk Pre-Prep and Nursery, your child is at the heart of everything we do. We specialise in the care and education of children aged 2 to 7 - a truly magical and formative phase in their learning journey. Our nurturing environment and carefully designed curriculum allow children to grow, explore and thrive in every area of life. We have high expectations in all aspects of school life. Our passionate team delivers meaningful learning that inspires curiosity, creativity and confidence. Alongside strong academics, we place equal emphasis on personal growth - building kindness, honesty, and resilience from the earliest age. Every child is known and celebrated for who they are. We provide the right level of challenge and support to help them shine - and prepare them to take the next step with confidence and joy. I warmly invite you to visit us and discover what makes Glenesk such a special place to begin your child’s educational journey. Mrs Meredith-Bennett Headteacher
Independent Pre-Prep of the Year
We are delighted to have been shortlisted for Independent Pre-prep of the Year 2024. This nomination recognises our commitment to providing every child with the most perfect start in life, filled with magical memories.
FACILITIES & LOCATION
A wholesome learning environment for your child
Located in the leafy village of East Horsley, we provide age-appropriate facilities that enhance learning for your child. Bright, spacious classrooms and interactive areas in our purpose-built nursery create a comfortable and imaginative environment. Outdoor exploration is also encouraged with dedicated learning spaces and a nature area. We have a library that offers a wide range of books for young readers, while our main hall hosts vibrant performances. In our dedicated music room, children develop their musical talents through curricular and extra-curricular lessons. Additionally, our main building features an indoor heated swimming pool for aqua fun.
The best way to get to know us?
There is no better way to truly understand what makes our school so special than by visiting us in person. We warmly welcome you to join us for a personal tour, where you can see our classrooms in action on a typical school day, or attend one of our open events to experience the vibrant life of our community. Visitors always comment on how inspired they are by the engaging classroom displays, the joyful and purposeful atmosphere and the sense of belonging that fills our school. You will also have the opportunity to meet our Headteacher, Mrs Lisa Meredith-Bennett, and speak to our pupils about their own experiences of our remarkable school. To book your visit, simply click the button below or get in touch with our friendly Admissions team on 01483 282329 or [email protected]

pageCache.pageTitle: Creative & Performing Arts - Art, Music & Drama - Glenesk School
pageCache.text:
Creative & Performing Arts
Art, Music and Drama are essential parts of school life
At Glenesk School, our curriculum embraces the vibrant world of creative arts and music, nurturing the artistic talents and passions of our pupils. We recognise the invaluable role that creative expression plays in a well-rounded education, fostering innovation, self-expression, and personal growth. Our comprehensive arts and music curriculum is designed to inspire and empower students to explore their artistic abilities and develop a lifelong appreciation for the arts.
Art
Music
Drama
We appreciate the beauty of artistic expression
Join us on a Private Tour
Pupils enter a world of melodies, harmonies, and rhythmic beats
Music at Glenesk School is a vibrant and integral part of the students' educational experience. The school recognises the immense power of music in nurturing creativity, enhancing cognitive abilities, and fostering a sense of community. As they progress through the school, they have the opportunity to learn a wide range of instruments, including piano, guitar, violin, drums, and more. Dedicated and highly skilled music teachers guide the students, helping them discover their talents and encouraging them to pursue their passion for music.
Drama lessons are part of our core curriculum
Drama plays a crucial role in our curriculum, providing students with a platform to explore their artistic abilities, build confidence, and develop crucial life skills. From the moment they step into the spotlight, our students embark on a thrilling journey of self-expression and discovery. Throughout the year, our dedicated drama department works tirelessly to cultivate a nurturing and inclusive environment where every student feels empowered to express themselves. We believe that drama is not only about the final performance but also the process of collaboration, teamwork, and personal growth.
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

Wraparound Care
Prioritising the wellbeing of our pupils
We understand the importance of providing comprehensive support for our pupils and their families beyond the regular school day. Our wraparound care program is designed to ensure that every child's needs are met holistically, encompassing their academic, emotional, and physical wellbeing. With a team of dedicated and experienced professionals, we offer a safe and nurturing environment where students can thrive outside the classroom. From extended hours of supervision to engaging enrichment activities, our wraparound care program strives to create a seamless transition between school and home, fostering a sense of belonging and continuity for our pupils. We are committed to providing exceptional care that aligns with our school's values, promoting character development, fostering friendships, and nurturing each child's individual growth.
Join us on a Private Tour
Before school
Our Early Birds club operates from 7.45am in the morning until the start of the school day at 8.30am. Children can play in the class or garden, draw or read books. Early Birds does not include breakfast.
After school
We run a very popular Stay & Play club from the end of the school day until 6.00pm where your child can enjoy playing or relaxing after the busy school day, supervised by qualified staff. For the children who stay late, a hot meal is provided at 4.30pm. We ask that you give us at least 24 hours’ notice if your child will be using this service to ensure that we have the correct staffing levels. Please book through the Cognita Connect app before 11am on the day. We also offer a range of after school clubs.
Holiday Clubs
Our holiday camps are run by SuperCamps, a division of Cognita for over 10 years and leading provider of childcare in the UK for over 20 years. SuperCamps ensure the highest standard of care in line with the Cognita family values. They are led by qualified and experienced staff, offering a wide range of fun and engaging activities for children age 4 -12 throughout the school holidays. At Supercamps at Glenesk School, we also offer a holiday camp provision for our Nursery children from age 2-3. These places are just for Glenesk Nursery children and can be booked by calling Supercamps directly. Places are limited so early booking is advised.
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

Download our prospectus
To download a copy of our prospectus, please share some basic information below.
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

Inspection Reports
ISI Regulatory Compliance Inspection Report 2020
The curriculum is documented, supported by appropriate plans and schemes of work for the pupils and covers the required breadth of material. The teaching enables pupils to make good progress, encompasses effective behaviour management and is supported by suitable resources. A suitable framework for the assessment of pupils’ performance is in place.
Principles and values are actively promoted which facilitate the personal development of pupils as responsible, tolerant, law-abiding citizens.
The proprietor ensures that the leadership and management demonstrate good skills and knowledge, and fulfil their responsibilities effectively, so that the other standards are consistently met, and they actively promote the well-being of the pupils.
Glenesk School ISI Inspection May 2024
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

Sport & Competition
Our students enjoy a healthy and active lifestyle
At Glenesk, we believe that sport and recreational play is crucial to every child’s development and their wellbeing. Not only does participating in sport have the obvious physical and mental health benefits for your child, but it also encourages the acquisition of life skills such as learning to be part of a team, leadership, good sportsmanship and graciously accepting win or defeat. Emphasis is placed on participation, where pupils have every opportunity to learn new skills and develop their talents.
Pupils have the opportunity to experience a wide array of physical pursuits
At Glenesk School, the Physical Education curriculum is designed to foster the holistic development of every pupil, promoting their physical fitness, social skills, and overall wellbeing. The school recognises the importance of physical activity and aims to provide a diverse range of activities to engage and challenge students of all abilities. The PE curriculum at Glenesk School is comprehensive and well-rounded, encompassing various sports, games, and fitness activities. It offers a balanced mix of individual and team sports, allowing pupils to explore their personal interests and develop crucial teamwork and leadership skills. Our Year 1 & 2 children regularly attend sporting events and competitions, both at other local schools and hosted by us.
Join us on a Private Tour
A variety of activities
We are fortunate enough to have our own heated indoor swimming pool, so every child has the opportunity to learn to swim throughout the academic year, from the age of 3. In addition, we focus on building good foundations in a wide variety of sports including athletics, cricket, football, gymnastics, basketball, tennis and touch rugby. We have specialist teachers for gymnastics, sports and swimming, and we often participate in athletics and sports matches with other local schools. There is also a wide range of extra-curricular sport available, including multisports, swimming, judo, football and dance. These clubs give children additional opportunities to pursue their interested and develop their sporting skills.
Our sports programme helps students to develop their physical skills
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

Extra-Curricular
Enhancing the curriculum
We believe that education extends far beyond the traditional classroom setting. That's why we offer a wide range of enriching extra-curricular activities, taught by specialist teachers, that cater to the diverse interests and talents of our students. From sports clubs to creative arts programs, our extra-curricular activities provide valuable opportunities for students to find new passions, develop essential skills, and cultivate a well-rounded education.
A wealth of opportunities
We aim to provide a wealth of opportunities to complement, extend and enrich those already offered by the school curriculum. We particularly focus on the creative arts through dance, drama and art, all of which we incorporate into the curriculum, but offer additional opportunities to extend this outside of classes. Years 1 and 2 learn to play recorders in their music lessons and individual piano lessons are available. We hold frequent concerts and plays are performed on the large stage in the main hall. Other after school activities include a range of clubs such as dance, cookery, forest school, football, tag rugby, judo and swimming. We also enrich the curriculum with a wide range of whole school activities and regular visits to places of educational interest, such as the British Wildlife Centre, Windsor Castle, Kew Gardens and the Rural Life Centre.
Join us on a Private Tour
Take a look at our most popular clubs
The Dance Club at Glenesk School is a vibrant and dynamic extra-curricular activity that allows students to express their creativity, develop their physical coordination, and build a strong sense of teamwork.
We offer an exciting opportunity for students to engage in the world's most popular sport, develop their athletic abilities, and foster a sense of camaraderie among teammates.
Choi Kwang Do provides students with an empowering and disciplined environment where children can develop their self control, enhance their co-ordination and stamina, and cultivate a strong sense of discipline and respect.
Whether students are beginners or aspiring competitive swimmers, our swimming club provides a supportive and inclusive environment where they can build confidence, stay active, and embrace the joy of swimming.
Wraparound Care
We understand the importance of providing a safe and nurturing environment where children can thrive even outside the classroom. With a dedicated team of professionals, we ensure that every child's needs are met, encompassing their academic, emotional, and physical well-being. From extended hours of supervision to engaging enrichment activities, our wraparound care program promotes a seamless transition between school and home.
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

pageCache.pageTitle: Private Nursery In Surrey - Glenesk School
pageCache.text:
Nursery
A nurturing and engaging environment for young children
Our nursery is a vibrant and nurturing environment where young minds embark on their educational journey. It provides a safe and stimulating space for children aged two to three years old. With its dedicated team of caring and experienced educators, the nursery focuses on creating a holistic learning experience that promotes the social, emotional, cognitive, and physical development of each child.
Cultivating a love for learning
At Glenesk, we recognise that every child is unique. We understand how children learn and provide them with tools and opportunities tailored to the way they experience the world. This allows our children to learn through experiences and exploration, inspiring the joy of discovery. Our children are given the opportunity to build on key learning skills, such as listening, speaking, concentration and learning to work together with their peers in a happy and secure environment. We use a successful Key Person system, so your child forms a secure emotional attachment and bond with one of our highly-qualified members of staff.
Children may start with us as soon as they turn 2 and can join at any point during the year and may attend our Nursery full-time, or parents can choose the sessions they require with a minimum attendance of two morning sessions per week. We also offer holiday clubs on site run by an external provider throughout the school holidays so your little one can be cared for by us year-round (spaces are limited). Our Nursery is very popular so early registration is recommended.
We offer full-time or part-time places
Children who attend our nursery can attend on a full time basis, extended morning sessions or for the morning only. We have a minimum session requirement of 2 sessions per week and we recommend that children add on a session each term building towards a minimum of 4/5 sessions a week in the term before they move up to Rising Reception.
Our full day in Nursery is 8.40 - 15.15
Our extended morning session is 8.40 - 13.30
Our morning only is 8.40 - 12.00 for Nursery
Fees are charged per school term and there are 3 terms per year. Children who attend our full days and extended morning sessions have lunch included in their fees.

pageCache.pageTitle: Reception - Private School In Leatherhead - Glenesk
pageCache.text:
Reception
We provide a springboard for learning
We teach through a balance of structured play and teaching, promoting curiosity and confidence. Your child’s happiness and success is at the heart of everything we do here at Glenesk and as your child takes the first formal steps along their educational journey, we will provide them with exceptional teaching, small class sizes and superb pastoral care.
A curriculum that inspires
Like Nursery and Rising Reception, we continue follow an enhanced EYFS curriculum, with an emphasis on first-hand learning and well-structured play activities enhanced with a range of rich learning experiences and activities.
Personal, social and emotional development
Communication and language
Understanding of the world
Physical development
Expressive arts and design
Results that speak for themselves
All our children learn at their own pace the results are a testament to the school's holistic approach to education. The highly skilled and passionate teaching staff have provided a nurturing and stimulating environment where each child is encouraged to reach their full potential. Our recent SIS inspection said: “Children’s attainment is well above national average across early years." At the end of Reception 89 per cent of our children are working at emerging or exceeding level, 20 per cent higher than the county average.
Monitoring your child's progress
Throughout the year we build a profile of each child using observation notes, samples of work and photographs, which reflects the child’s achievement and progress. You will receive regular updates with an opportunity to meet with their teacher at Parent’s Evenings held in the Autumn and Spring terms, alongside access to them at all times.
Gaining real-world experiences outside the classroom
Educational visits are organised and supported to enhance the delivery of the curriculum, along with visitors to school and involvement by parents and other caregivers, so they can support their child’s individual learning journey. Our pupil’s social development is very important and we put a strong emphasis on traditional values, such as good manners, respect for others and individual responsibility.
Join us on a Private Tour
Begin an unforgettable adventure
Learn more
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

Redshift Education
Opening the door to a global learning community
Glenesk School is proud to be part of Redshift Education, a diverse global community of over 5 schools that share one common purpose: to enable students to thrive in a rapidly evolving world. Redshift Education achieve this by providing an outstanding holistic education that delivers the best academic outcomes for each and every student. A balanced combination of cognitive, social, emotional and physical learning, alongside rich learning opportunities, also helps students to develop agency, adaptability and positive attitudes – skills that are required to thrive in life.
Continuously improving the quality of education
Redshift Education’s evidence-based framework provides clear guidance on what makes an excellent school. Using this as a guide, Redshift Education works with school leaders to drive continuous improvement in educational practice across all our schools in a way that works best for each school community. Having access to a global staffroom means that we make the most of our diverse community by sharing best practice, connecting and collaborating across the miles. And our teachers benefit from formal professional development opportunities such as the Team Fellowship and Senior Leader Enquiry programmes, developed and run in partnership with the world-leading IOE, Faculty of Education and Society at UCL.
Prioritising the safety and wellbeing of our students
Our uncompromising culture of care ensures the safety and wellbeing of all children is at the heart of Redshift Education. This includes the security of our learning environments, the emotional wellbeing of our students, the rigorous vetting of our staff, and robust policies, procedures and training in child safeguarding. Every Redshift Education school has a regular independent safeguarding review and is monitored and assessed to ensure they go above and beyond what is required by regulators.

pageCache.pageTitle: Rising Reception - Transition from Nursery To Reception
pageCache.text:
Rising Reception
Providing the perfect bridge between Nursery and Reception
Our children start Rising Reception at the age of three and this year ensures a smooth transition between Nursery and Reception. We believe that the Early Years builds a foundation for a love of learning, which will stay with your child for the rest of their lives, whatever their individual strengths.
The first big step on their academic journey
Our children follow a richly diverse and tailor-made EYFS curriculum, focusing on stimulating their development through communication and language, physical development and personal, social and emotional development. Everything we do is designed to provide active involvement and relevant first-hand opportunities, in an environment filled with possibilities. Our teachers and specialist staff, engage with pupils to encourage curiosity, self-confidence, independence and good manners, laying the best possible foundations for positive learning in the future.
Our small class sizes and excellent pupil teacher ratios means we can focus on teaching small groups, with work designed for every pupil, to ensure your child’s learning is designed uniquely for them. In the afternoon sessions, we run different themed afternoon including cookery, science discovery, forest school and swimming in our indoor heated pool.
We offer different sessions that suit your schedule
Your child may attend Rising Reception full time or morning or afternoon sessions, as required. Lunches are made freshly on-site and your child is welcome to stay for lunch even if they go home in the afternoon. Rising Reception Session Times are: 8.30am-12.30pm (morning only) 8.30am-1.30pm (including lunch) 8.30am-3.15pm (full day)
Five mornings and one afternoon in the Autumn term
Five mornings and two afternoons in the Spring Term
Five mornings and three afternoons in the Summer Term

About Us
Part of Redshift Education
By being part of Redshift Education, we open the door to a community of over 5 schools that’s rich in knowledge, opportunities, and best practices, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class. We are proud to be part of this community and actively help to shape it. Each school within Redshift Education preserves its distinct character and remains deeply rooted in its local community. Crucially, these diverse experiences across the world foster inspiration, shared support, and growth opportunities for every school within our group. Our students and teachers are more than just learners and educators; they are active global citizens. Together, they are exposed to a variety of perspectives from diverse cultures, sharing and gaining insights that transcend traditional classroom boundaries. This dynamic exchange fosters a learning space where young minds, guided by their teachers, are encouraged to express their unique ideas and talents, while instilling the value of respect and embracing the spirit of collaboration. It’s an individual approach that empowers our school, every teacher, and each student to discover what they truly do best. And thrive.

Academic Excellence
Empowering students to reach their full potential
As a non-selective school, we are extremely proud of our record of academic excellence. We have the best specialist teachers and exceptional facilities. With small class sizes, all children receive individualised attention and are given the opportunity to truly fulfil their potential, grow in confidence and unlock their unique strengths and talents.
Join us on a Private Tour
Helping parents select the best school for their child
One of the key roles as Head of Glenesk is to engage with parents early on in their child’s educational career to help them choose the best future school to suit their child’s character and academic ability. Mrs Meredith-Bennett has a wealth of experience in this field and close links with Heads and Registrars of all the top-tier schools in the local area. She is able to offer parents exceptional advice and support every step of the way and 100% of our children are successful in getting in to the school of their choice.
Preparing students for their next steps
We have a longstanding reputation as one of the best schools for preparing children for entry to the top Prep Schools in the area. Our strong academic record and excellent pastoral care gives our pupils a noticeable edge as they move forwards on their school journey. Our Year 2 children have the unique opportunity to become leaders at age 7 through holding positions of responsibility and being role models for the younger children which gives them a distinctive confidence. Many of our leavers have won academic and sporting scholarships and over the last 4 years our leavers have gained places at some of the best destination schools.

pageCache.pageTitle: Private School Admissions Process - Glenesk School
pageCache.text:
Admissions Process
Joining us is straightforward
Apply for a place at our exceptional school and put your child on the path to a fantastic educational experience. We have designed our admissions process to be as easy as possible and we will happily guide you every step of the way.
Easy 5 step process
Give our Admissions Manager a call on 01483 282329 to discuss your child's needs, check availability and find out more about our impressive school.
Appointments for a private tour of the school may be made through our Admissions Manager, Emily Collins and these usually last about an hour and a half. Our Headteacher, Mrs Lisa Meredith-Bennett, will take you on a tour of the school and answer any questions you may have regarding your child’s future education.
Following this initial meeting and tour of the school you may register your child for the appropriate class and the preferred date of entry by completing a registration form and paying a non-returnable registration fee of £120. Places are not guaranteed at this stage and will only be formally offered at acceptance stage pending availability and/or after a taster visit. For Nursery and Rising Reception places a child’s date of birth, date of registration, desired entry date, sibling priority, number of sessions required and whether the parents are also considering the school for their child will also be taken into consideration when offering places.
If a place is available that matches your requirements an acceptance pack with all the necessary paperwork to confirm a child’s place is sent out 1 term before entry in order to formally finalise the place. A deposit of £500 is required to secure your place, and is returned when your child leaves the school with a terms notice.
For new children joining Reception and above taster sessions are offered and for those in Nursery and Rising Reception, settling in sessions will be discussed with the class teachers. Our Parents Association, Friends of Glenesk School (FOGS) hold regular parents coffee mornings and social events which new parents can join.
Join us for a Private Tour
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

pageCache.pageTitle: Our School Mission & Values – Glenesk School
pageCache.text:
Mission & Values
Encouraging each child to reach their full potential
At Glenesk School, our mission is to provide a nurturing and inspiring educational environment that empowers every child to flourish academically, emotionally, and socially. We believe that education should not only focus on academic excellence but also on cultivating essential values and skills that will guide our pupils throughout their lives. With a deep commitment to fostering a love of learning, promoting creativity, and embracing diversity, Glenesk School strives to create a supportive community where each child's unique talents and potential are recognised, celebrated, and nurtured. By instilling a strong sense of integrity, empathy, and resilience, we aim to prepare our pupils to become compassionate individuals who make a positive impact on the world around them.
Join us on a Private Tour
Our Aims & Ethos
To create an environment where safeguarding is a priority, where all children feel safe and secure and as a result can flourish and grow emotionally.
To provide high quality teaching and learning, which inspires a spirit of enquiry, challenge and exploration and encourages each child to develop as lifelong learners.
To provide a holistic approach, with a balanced focus on the intellectual, moral, spiritual, physical and emotional development of every child.
To develop an environment in which traditional British values, thoughtfulness, compassion and respect for others play an important part.
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School

Wellbeing & Support
We provide students with the emotional support they need to thrive
The wellbeing and support of our students are paramount. We believe that a nurturing and inclusive environment is essential for their overall development and happiness. Our dedicated staff members work tirelessly to create a positive and caring atmosphere, where every child feels valued and supported.
Join us on a Private Tour
Committed to the welfare and safety of our students
Safeguarding is of paramount importance, and the wellbeing of every student is our top priority. We have implemented a comprehensive framework of policies, procedures, and practices ensuring a safe and secure environment for all members of our school community.
Supporting every child
Glenesk supports children with learning difficulties through a dedicated Special Educational Needs Co-ordinator who provides extra support individually or in small groups. The SENCO collaborates with teachers to plan, monitor, and review special needs provision, ensuring differentiated learning for each student. The school also caters to able and gifted children, providing challenging and stimulating experiences tailored to their individual needs.
Glenesk Pre-Preparatory School
